summary: Develop and maintain secure, performant Java applications for SERPRO/Receita Federal tax-reform projects. Design components and data models, write unit tests and traceable code changes, maintain development/build environments and participate in Scrum ceremonies.
requirements: Fullstack Java background with at least one listed stack combination: React/Oracle; Spring Boot/Angular; Quarkus/Kafka/Angular; Spring Boot/Kafka/Angular/MongoDB; Spring Boot/Kafka; or Java 8/Kafka/Angular 4. Secure development/privacy, UML and data modeling, CI/CD, version/build/release tools, WCAG 2, SAST/DAST/HP Fortify, REST/design patterns, monolithic and decoupled systems, unit testing and Git. Completed MEC-recognized IT degree, OR any completed recognized degree plus a completed software-engineering/development postgraduate course of at least 360 hours. No minimum year count or language requirement is disclosed.
compensation: Amount not disclosed; payments are monthly for active assignments.
conditions: Senior remote role in Brazil, PJ with non-exclusive dedication. SERPRO contract spans October 2026–October 2028. Allocation is by client service orders with start/end dates; gaps between orders may mean no work and no billing. Minimum productivity and quality targets apply. Daily/weekly hours are not disclosed.
